sources.title: Overarching National Policy Statement for energy (EN-1), 2025
sources.facts: Sets overarching policy and assessment principles for nationally significant energy infrastructure.
sources.guard: An NPS does not prove a particular scheme meets policy or will receive consent.

sources.title: EN-1, 2025 accessible webpage
sources.facts: Explains need, assessment principles, generic impacts and the role of electricity storage.
sources.guard: National need does not prove local capacity, connection, safety or deliverability.

sources.title: National Policy Statement for renewable energy infrastructure (EN-3), 2025
sources.facts: Sets technology-specific policy for major solar, wind, tidal, biomass and pumped-hydro projects.
sources.guard: Technology policy does not prove site suitability, impact acceptability or consent.

sources.title: EN-3, 2025 accessible webpage
sources.facts: Provides thresholds and technology-specific assessment considerations.
sources.guard: Thresholds and assessment criteria do not establish application status or approval.

sources.title: Renewable and low carbon energy
sources.facts: Covers local renewable strategy, solar, wind and battery-energy-storage planning considerations.
sources.guard: Planning guidance does not prove a BESS or renewable project is safe, permitted or connected.

sources.title: National Policy Statements for energy infrastructure
sources.facts: Collects current energy National Policy Statements and associated assessments.
sources.guard: A collection page does not prove completeness for a specific project or decision date.

sources.title: National Policy Statements for energy: appraisal of sustainability
sources.facts: Assesses likely significant sustainability effects of infrastructure covered by energy NPSs.
sources.guard: Strategic appraisal is not a project EIA or site-specific mitigation result.

sources.title: One Earth Solar Farm development consent decision announced
sources.facts: Records a July 2026 solar and BESS development-consent decision and statutory process.
sources.guard: One consent decision is not evidence that another project is acceptable or deliverable.
